arStrings.szText: "You know that man? Who, or what, is he?"
He is... Once, he was the prince of Khanduras. Aidan. Taken by the Lord of Terror, to be his vessel.
Tired, heavy, somber. He mourns this man.
But he was slain long ago...and I...I...I was...
Suddenly confused, not sure where or when he is. Starts to remember he too was slain.
Cain. Deckard...Cain, of the Horadrim. Forgive me. I am not entirely sure what has happened. But Aidan must be stopped. As must the others...
You fought well...withstood his evil. I'm afraid I badly need your help.
Please, meet me at the Imperial Library. I must consult with the Yshari and get my bearings. Sanctuary depends on it.
